title: BEST TRACKER APP
body:
I’ve been using it for about 3 months. Has helped me tremendously in getting insights into my habits. Im using the pro version with the one time payment and compared to other apps with a monthly fee it’s a steal. 
Love the simplicity. 
I recommend this app to all my coaching clients.

title: Very good app
body: I downloaded all the free / lite habit trackers I could find. In the end this was the best. Fun, easy to use and practical. Only thing I would like to see added is an option to choose how many days a week you want to do your good habit or avoid the bad. So, example, i set a goal to spend 3 hours a day on marketing my business, but i only want to do this 5 days a week not 7. This is minor though and overall it's a very good app.
author: Forestskog
